errors.text_span: 它们显示了“通用语->语面语”、“口语->通用语”、“口语->语面语”和“通用语->书面语”的比例。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the four categories. The actual categories are “口语->通用语->书面语” (15.7%), “口语->通用语” (13.9%), “口语->书面语” (6.4%), and “通用语->书面语” (63.9%). The description misses the first category, duplicates the last one, and contains typos (“语面语” instead of “书面语”).

errors.text_span: 视觉上，切片以大小递减的顺序排列。
errors.evidence: The statement that the slices are arranged in descending order of size is incorrect. The slices, in order of size, are 63.9%, 15.7%, 13.9%, and 6.4%, but they are not arranged sequentially in this order around the pie chart.

errors.text_span: 切片“通用语->语面语”为黄色，占比大约63.9%
errors.evidence: The label for the yellow slice (63.9%) is “通用语->书面语”. The description uses an incorrect label “通用语->语面语”, which contains a typo (面 instead of 书).

errors.text_span: “口语->语面语”为红色，占比大约6.4%
errors.evidence: This description contains two errors. The label for the 6.4% slice is “口语->书面语”, but the description has a typo (“语面语”). Additionally, the color of this slice is grey, not red (红色).

errors.text_span: “通用语->书面语”为浅蓝色，占比大约15.7%
errors.evidence: The label for the light blue slice (15.7%) is “口语->通用语->书面语”. The description incorrectly assigns it the label “通用语->书面语”, which actually corresponds to the yellow slice (63.9%).

errors.text_span: 切片内没有显示百分比标签。
errors.evidence: This statement is false. Percentage values are clearly displayed inside each slice of the pie chart (e.g., 63.9%, 15.7%).
